info.description: Spatio-temporal maps for Grafana dashboards — trajectories, origin-destination flows and velocity fields from any data source. Runs kepler.gl inside the panel.

screenshots.name: Vector, aggregated and cloud-native raster layers of one place, stacked on a Grafana time bar
The Amazon drainage as a velocity field, traced from origin-destination rows
A live transit fleet, each vehicle a symbol turned to its heading and coloured by punctuality
Origin-destination flows built from query rows: taxi trips of the last ten minutes, in three dimensions
Global seismicity read as remote GeoParquet by DuckDB, with the time filter and its playback
